title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jackson Koivun's Pro Debut
items.text: Jackson Koivun leads the 3M Open in his third professional start with a final-round 65, breaking the tournament scoring record after delaying turning pro to ready himself mentally.

items.headline: Rocket Classic's Rooftop Par 3
items.text: The Rocket Classic introduced its unique 'Par 3 in the D' rooftop challenge ahead of its final PGA Tour event at Detroit Golf Club.

items.headline: Major leader Withdraws from Rocket Classic
items.text: A major leader withdrew from the Rocket Classic due to a back injury, impacting the field just before the FedExCup Playoffs.
